method: AI-assisted pre-check: each claim compared with its exact quoted source passages (Caraka Ci.16, Astangahrdaya Ni.13, Susruta Utt.44, 1890 Kaviratna translation); selected formulation and symptom claims cross-checked against independent web sources.
notice: NOT a practitioner review. This pre-check does not verify, approve or promote any claim; every claim stays 'unverified' until a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner reviews it.

claims.claim: Pandu SUGGESTS_PRINCIPLE Oleation with medicated ghee (snehana) in Pandu
claims.statement: Medicated ghee is given for oleation to persons with Pandu and Kamala.
claims.ai_note: The quoted source passage states the claim.

claims.claim: Pandu SUGGESTS_PRINCIPLE Purification (saṃśodhana) with sharp emetic and purgative drugs after oleation, in Pandu
claims.statement: A person with Pandu, after oleation, is to be purified with sharp drugs acting upwards and downwards (emesis and purgation).
claims.ai_note: The quoted source passage states the claim.

claims.claim: Pandu SUGGESTS_PRINCIPLE Wholesome diet (pathya) after purification, in Pandu
claims.statement: After purification, wholesome foods are to be given.
claims.ai_note: The quoted source passage states the claim.

claims.claim: Pandu SUGGESTS_PRINCIPLE Medication chosen according to the predominant dosha, in Pandu
claims.statement: Specific medicines are to be given according to the dosha involved.
claims.ai_note: The quoted source passage states the claim.

claims.claim: Wholesome diet (pathya) after purification, in Pandu RECOMMENDS_DIET Old śāli rice, barley and wheat with soups
claims.statement: The wholesome diet consists of old śāli rice, barley and wheat taken with soups.
claims.ai_note: The quoted source passage states the claim.

claims.claim: Wholesome diet (pathya) after purification, in Pandu RECOMMENDS_DIET Soups of mung bean, pigeon pea and lentil
claims.statement: Soups of mung bean, pigeon pea and lentil are part of the wholesome diet.
claims.ai_note: The quoted source passage states the claim.

claims.claim: Wholesome diet (pathya) after purification, in Pandu RECOMMENDS_DIET Meat soups of dry-land (jāṅgala) animals
claims.statement: Meat soups of dry-land animals are described as beneficial in the wholesome diet.
claims.ai_note: The quoted source passage states the claim.

claims.claim: Wholesome diet (pathya) after purification, in Pandu RECOMMENDS_DIET Water boiled with the sthirādi group of drugs, for drinking and cooking
claims.statement: Water boiled with the sthirādi drugs is praised for drinking and food for persons with Pandu (grape and āmalakī juice is given for Kamala in the same verse).
claims.ai_note: Verse continues into Ca.6.16.115; which drink is meant for Pandu and which for Kamala depends on reading across the verse boundary.
